Among them: • Reinsuring a $10 billion block of traditional variable annuities. • Partnering with Warburg Pincus, we launched Prismic, a life and annuity reinsurance company, to which we reinsured a block of structured settlement annuity contracts with reserves of approximately $10 billion. The formation of Prismic offers an exciting opportunity to drive growth by leveraging our differentiated brand, global asset and liability origination capabilities, and multichannel distribution. Thanks to the hard work and innovation of our employees, we are creating the next generation of financial solutions and delivering industry-leading customer experiences. We’re leveraging technology to bring more products to market faster. It marked our first transaction in the Dutch market and our second-largest longevity risk transfer transaction, and reinforces our confidence in opportunities for growth in this arena. • Addressing demand for a workplace retirement income option by partnering with Fidelity Investments to make a new single-premium immediate annuity available to employer-based retirement plans administered by Fidelity. We also continued to invest in our international insurance businesses, including our market-leading Japanese life insurance companies, and our operations in high-growth emerging markets. Key 2023 accomplishments include: • In Japan, where we have a differentiated multichannel distribution model, we diversified our portfolio with new inheritance and investment products, to meet a broader range of customer needs. • In Latin America, we continued to expand third-party distribution of life and accident insurance through our partnership with Mercado Pago, a platform on Mercado Libre, the region’s largest e-commerce ecosystem. • In Brazil, we achieved record sales growth for the year, driven by third-party distribution and strong results from our Life Planner channel. As we look ahead, we are well positioned across our businesses to achieve our vision of being a global leader in expanding access to investing, insurance, and retirement security. Delivering enhanced shareholder value Throughout Prudential’s history, our strong balance sheet and robust risk and capital management frameworks have allowed us to confidently navigate financial and macroeconomic challenges. Our financial strength is supported by $4.1 billion in highly liquid assets, as of Dec. 31, 2023, as well as a high-quality, well-diversified investment portfolio and a disciplined approach to asset- liability management. Our systematic approach to capital deployment also enables us to effectively balance investing in the growth of our businesses with returning capital to shareholders. Strengthening communities and forging paths to financial security Prudential was founded on the belief that financial security should be within reach for everyone. We are also investing in community organizations that help expand access to economic mobility and improve social systems. In 2023, we made grants of more than $43 million, plus nearly $21 million in corporate contributions, to nonprofit organizations. In addition, through our impact investing portfolio of more than $1 billion, we’re investing in businesses and other organizations that seek to create both financial and social returns. Cultivating our talent and culture Our employees’ talents and ideas, and our unique company culture, are crucial to our ability to succeed. That’s why we continue to devote significant resources to talent management, to help our employees develop skills they need for their careers — and Prudential — to grow. For example, we’ve expanded employee access to development and career advancement opportunities through online resources, coaching circles and leadership programs. We also offer a variety of benefits to support our employees’ well-being and help them care for their loved ones. Our commitment to integrity, equity and inclusion also remains a hallmark of our company. We understand that having a workforce with diverse backgrounds, as well as an inclusive culture and business practices, is critical to understanding and meeting the needs of our customers, creating more paths to financial security for more people, and realizing our growth aspirations. Looking ahead with confidence In 2025, Prudential will mark its 150th anniversary. As we reflect on our proud legacy, we are excited about the opportunities ahead and determined to deliver on our promises and potential. We are confident that, thanks to our talented workforce, financial strength, and differentiated strategy, we are positioned to succeed and continue leading the way in expanding access to investing, insurance, and retirement security. We look forward to sharing our progress with you and our other valued stakeholders. Thank you for your continued interest in our company. Charles F. Lowrey Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
